description: Get the content of a specific section from the PDF specification (ISO 32000-2). Returns structured content including headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, and notes. A parent section returns its entire subtree (all subsections, in document order); top-level clauses can therefore return very large responses — prefer the most specific section number you know.

spec.description: Spec ID (e.g. "iso32000-2", "pdf17"). Omit for the default spec.

name: get_section
title: Get section content
